lane_single_method: TILTZERO-CONCORD de-novo emission: coincident tilt-angle zero-crossings of organizer-provided training_features.tif magnetic field (Band 9 tmi_vg / Band 3 tmi_hg) and gravity field (Band 11 iso_grav_anom_vg / Band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg). Surface = geometric mean of percentile ranks of magnetic analytic signal sqrt(B3^2+B9^2), magnetic tilt-closeness exp(-(atan2(B9,B3)/0.15)^2), gravity analytic signal sqrt(B18^2+B11^2), gravity tilt-closeness exp(-(atan2(B11,B18)/0.15)^2), each percentile-ranked inside footprint. 1-D directional NMS pool on that surface, exactly 37,654 binary dots de novo at >=3.5 px mutual spacing and >3.0 px from catalogue (visible-only inside holdout folds). No Hessian crest (PROVCREST lane), no Bands 19/15, no external data, no catalogue-derived ranking.
hypothesis_ranking_context: research/candidate-hypotheses-20261024-tiltzero.md ranks 5 candidates; this is Rank 1 by expected DTI/cost. Promotion additionally requires beating the current shipped holdout best PROVCREST HOLDOUT-DTI 0.076277 (registry/provcrest_run_card.json) on the identical pooled seeds 20+30 instrument; beating only R0 is necessary but not sufficient for an OK-TO-SUBMIT label in this session (user instruction: do not spend a slot on an idea that has not beaten the current holdout best).

EXP1_tiltzero_rank.selection: greedy descending TILTZERO surface, >=3.5 px blocked acceptance
EXP1_tiltzero_rank.predicted_holdout_dti_vs_r0_control: MODEL:+0.02 to +0.09 vs R0; tilt zero-crossings sit over potential-field source edges (faulted basement contacts) whether mapped or not
EXP1_tiltzero_rank.falsifier: Pooled HOLDOUT-DTI <= R0, paired CI includes 0, <= PROVCREST 0.076277, canary >0.90, or uniqueness/validator failure -> verdict negative, DO-NOT-SUBMIT

EXP2_tiltzero_randorder.selection: seeded random order (default_rng 20261024) over identical NMS pool, identical locks
EXP2_tiltzero_randorder.predicted_holdout_dti_vs_rank: MODEL:-0.03 to 0.00 vs EXP1 if surface ranking carries signal
EXP2_tiltzero_randorder.falsifier: If EXP2 >= EXP1, ranking is retired and EXP2 is the winner arm (still subject to all gates)

CONTROL_r0.selection: R0 evaluated unchanged on identical folds

gates.validator: no NaN/Inf anywhere, values subset {0,1} in [0,1], EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform = sample_submission, 0 dots on catalogue, min catalogue distance >3.0 px
gates.promotion_rule: promote only if winner beats R0 (paired CI>0) AND winner HOLDOUT-DTI > 0.076277 (PROVCREST shipped best) AND uniqueness+validator pass. Otherwise negative / DO-NOT-SUBMIT.

non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic contacts (Tertiary volcanic flow margins, pluton margins, tilted sedimentary hogback contacts) and remanent/reversed-polarity volcanic edges producing coincident magnetic+gravity tilt zero-crossings without brittle fault permeability.
